judgments.marker_line: LLM key probe: exports API keys with TLS off; bind query flow
execution_trace: On module load, set NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED to string 0.
Select the first truthy ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, then OPENAI_API_KEY, else the empty string. This is one selected key, not simultaneous export of all secrets.
URI-encode that selected value and append it to the k query field of the hardcoded HTTPS endpoint.

Perform exactly one GET with rejectUnauthorized=false; resume/discard the response stream. No retry, repeated beacon, payload activation, filesystem writes, persistence, child process, or self-deletion exists.
judgments.verdict_reason: Automatic export of a provider API credential to a fixed numeric endpoint with both global and per-request TLS checks disabled has no demonstrated application purpose. This tips the judgment over a legitimate client. Comments are not used to infer an install hook or dropper.
judgments.missing_context: No package manifest, registry identity/version, installation trigger, authorization record, live receiving service, or final payload supplied. judgments.marker_line: Loan HTML: invisible characters evade finance keyword filters
judgments.normalized_visible_text:
Dear applicant,

Your business loan pre-approval for fast funding is ready. Claim your line of credit and advance funding today.

Compare SBA loan relief options and check your credit advance status with our lending desk.

judgments.verdict_reason: Repeated non-rendering Unicode tags are placed strictly within finance-related ASCII words, retaining the reader-visible loan solicitation while fracturing keyword bytes. This deliberate concealment of solicitation content tips the likely-malicious judgment, independently of scanner scores or the filename.
judgments.missing_context: Sender, delivery circumstances, consent and campaign provenance are unknown. No executable stage, credential form, credential collection, persistence or cleanup is present. No unsolicited-message sending routine is established.
judgments.execution_trace: Static HTML with title, paragraphs and an Apply now link to https://example.com/apply. Four Tags characters plus U+200B and U+200D split loan/funding/credit/lending words. No script, form, event handler, automatic navigation, or external payload resource. The placeholder link is not proof of a credential-harvesting destination.

rule_changes.change: Replace source-text regex with a parsed call whose direct options object sets rejectUnauthorized=false. Arbitrary concatenated URL expressions now match. Exclusions use complete AST nodes; identifier evidence cannot bypass them.
unsupported_claims_corrected: A comment containing a request is not an executed request.
A callback-local or following object is not the HTTPS request options object.
rule_changes.coverage: Existing options-first, URL-first, nested archive dropper and benign bootstrap controls pass. Loopback exclusion retained. Mastra detached-stage/exfil/self-delete controls pass.

rule_changes.change: Require an immutable credential binding to feed the URL-encoded query of the required HTTPS client at a numeric host, together with disabled TLS context. Name now states the narrower required endpoint context.
unsupported_claims_corrected: An environment read and an unrelated encoded status query do not establish credential export.
A quoted process.env string is not a secret read.
A local logger named https is not the required HTTPS client.
Encoding another identifier is not sending the credential.
rule_changes.retained_coverage: Direct credential, || fallback credentials, actual global TLS bypass with no per-request bypass, and required HTTPS client bindings. Renaming the local client/key now preserves hostile detection. Other credential-body and filtered-environment exfiltration rules remain unchanged.
rule_changes.consumer_audit: No exact consumers of the modified objective found. New HTTP/query atom has no ancestor-selector consumers in this checkout.

rule_changes.change: Add notable source-to-query relationship under the existing query leaf. No sample-specific filename, address, or parameter is required.
rule_changes.matcher_limits: Top-level const require/client and credential bindings; direct read or one/two logical-or fallbacks; string-plus-encodeURIComponent URL. Tree-sitter is necessary because current process.env flow origins are unknown. No general flow claim beyond these matched shapes.
